Remarks indicating changes, if any, in the post operated
from 31.03.2023 to 31.03.2024

Consequent upon the transfer of Shri Amiya Ku. Swain,
Shri Kallol Bikash Swain was exercising the powers of
ED (Production) w.e.f.03.07.2023.
Subsequently, he was promoted as ED (Production)
w.e.f. 16.02.2024.

Consequent upon the superannuation of Shri Bhimsen
Pradhan, Shri Amiya K. Swain was transferred to S&P
Complex as ED(S&P) w.e.f. 03.07.2023.

Consequent upon the superannuation of Shri K. K.
Panda w.e.f. 30.06.2023, Shri Krishnendu Chatterjee
was posted as ED (P&T) w.e.f. 31.10.2023, who was
superannuated on 31.12.2023.
Subsequently, Shri Rasheed Waris assumed the charge
of ED (P&T) w.e.f. 19.02.2024 upon his promotion and
transfer to Corporate Office from M&R Complex.

Consequent upon the superannuation of Shri Subrata
Mohanty, w.e.f. 31.10.2023, the post of ED(BD) is lying
vacant.
